name: SmugMug

pricing.free_plan: 14-day trial. No free plan; storage and gallery features start at the Direct tier.

tiers.name: Direct
tiers.note: billed annually; unlimited storage, private galleries, digital delivery

tiers.name: Portfolio
tiers.note: billed annually; website templates, print and download sales

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.note: billed annually; pricelists, coupons, client favouriting

capabilities: Unlimited photo storage on every tier
Print and digital sales with fulfilment handled by SmugMug
limits: No free plan: nothing is public without paying
Website templates are less flexible than a design tool
RAW storage is a paid add-on
Onboarding is a seven-step survey before the first site exists; automated signup stalls there (checked 06.11.2026)
summary: Hosting-first platform: unlimited storage and print sales, website as a side product.
